headline: Pixel 11 Pro Fold design leaks ahead of Google's August 12th event
summary: Leaked renders reveal the Pixel 11 Pro Fold's design, alongside new Pixel Buds and a Pixel Watch, all expected at Google's upcoming hardware event. The foldable retains its tall outer screen and 8-inch inner display.
details: Weeks before Google's next Pixel hardware event, leaker Evan Blass has shared what appear to be marketing renders of the unannounced Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold. These images were posted on his Substack, giving an early look at the device.

If accurate, the new foldable will largely resemble last year's model, featuring a tall outer screen and retaining an 8-inch inner display. However, the back camera array has been slightly redesigned and will reportedly include the 'glowy light' previously teased for the Pixel 11 Pro.
Blass also posted renders of what are likely new Pixel Buds and a new Pixel Watch, both shown in an olive green color. Google has not yet responded to requests for comment regarding these leaks.

Google's Made by Google hardware event is scheduled for August 12th at 6 PM ET, where these Pixel devices are expected to be formally announced. The company has hinted at potentially higher prices for upcoming gadgets due to 'RAMaggedon'.

headline_marked: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra [[$450 Price Drop]] at Amazon, Lowest Ever
headline: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra $450 Price Drop at Amazon, Lowest Ever
summary: The premium Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra is now available for $1,050, a significant $450 discount from its original $1,500 launch price.
details: Samsung's Galaxy S26 Ultra, a device known for its peak specifications and performance, is now at its lowest price point. Originally launched at $1,500 for the 512GB model, Amazon is offering a limited-time deal that cuts $450 off the price, bringing it down to $1,050.

This flagship phone boasts a 6.9-inch AMOLED display with a 120Hz variable refresh rate, powered by a Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chip. It comes equipped with 12GB of RAM and 512GB of internal storage, ensuring smooth multitasking and ample space for apps and media.

Photography enthusiasts will appreciate the versatile camera system, featuring a 200MP main sensor, a 10MP 3x telephoto lens, a 50MP ultrawide camera, and a 50MP 10x telephoto lens. This setup is designed to capture stunning images in various lighting conditions.
The device is supported by a substantial 5,000mAh battery, offering all-day usage for most users. For charging, it supports 60W wired and 25W wireless charging, allowing for quick power-ups.

Samsung has committed to seven years of software updates for the Galaxy S26 Ultra, ensuring it remains current and feature-rich until 2033. This extended support, combined with the current discount, makes it a compelling option in the premium smartphone market.
